subject: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@caremap.ai>
Cc: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@caremap.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 17:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff

Hi Liam / Sara — thanks again for the time today. Quick readout and suggested next steps: 

- Key fit: Your use case (automated clinical note summarization + triage routing) looks aligned with Redwood's streaming generation + prefix caching approach.
- Priority success criteria (as discussed): 1) >= 92% helpfulness on sampled notes (you'll provide 200 examples), 2) mean generation latency < 350ms at 1 RPS baseline, 3) safe-handling of PHI per your retention policy.

Next asks / proposals: 
1) Schedule a 60-min evaluation kickoff (tech deep-dive + trial plan + prompt handoff). Recommend two windows this week: Thu 12/23 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri 12/24 13:00–14:00 PT.
2) Please share a short prompt set (5–10 examples) and a representative sample of notes (anonymized) — I attached a prompt template.
3) I'll attach a mutual action plan (MAP) draft; Neha (CC) will own success metric definitions and trial ops.

Attachments: CareMap_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, prompt_sample_v2.csv (prompt template)

If those slots don't work, send 2 alternatives and we'll lock one. 

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference — High-performance inference for production LLMs
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@caremap.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@caremap.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff

Thanks, Priyom — appreciated. Quick notes: 

- The priorities you captured are accurate. For (1) helpfulness we'll lean on clinical SMEs; can we align on the eval rubric beforehand?
- For PHI/data: our security lead needs to confirm acceptable anonymization for test data; I'll loop them if needed.

Regarding times: Thu 12/23 at 10:00 PT should work for me, but Sara is OOO that day until late afternoon. Can we do Fri 12/24 13:00 PT instead? If not, early next week Mon 12/27 morning PT is feasible.

I'll upload a redacted note sample by EOD tomorrow. Also — is there a preferred format for the prompt set? CSV okay?

Liam
Lead Product Manager
CareMap Health
liam.oconnor@caremap.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@caremap.ai>
Cc: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@caremap.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 12:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff

Perfect — CSV is ideal for the prompt set. Thanks for offering to upload the redacted notes. 

Neha, Ben — can you join the kickoff? Neha will lead success criteria definition and trial cadence; Ben can cover runtime/latency expectations and model selection tradeoffs.

Liam — I can confirm Fri 12/24 13:00 PT now. I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda: intros, success criteria draft, trial plan (scope/length), prompt handoff, security/data checklist, and next steps (MAP sign-off & trial activation).

One small ask: do you want us to provision a private trial project (VPC) or start on hosted with data redaction? If your security lead prefers, we can stand up a dedicated private project for the evaluation. We'll treat this as a discovery input for the MAP.

Quick follow-up items for you before the call: 
- Upload 200 anonymized notes (S3 link or Drive) — even 100 is fine for a first pass.
- Share 5–10 prompt examples in CSV (prompt,input,expected_output).

I'll attach the MAP draft in the calendar invite.

Thanks — sending invite now.

Priyom
From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@caremap.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@caremap.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:54:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff

Thanks — confirmed Fri 12/24 13:00 PT on my calendar. I've also added our security lead (Mark Chen) to the invite — Mark will be there for the data-handling discussion. 

A couple of quick notes from our side: 
- We'll provide a redacted sample set (aiming for 150 notes) by tomorrow morning.
- For the eval rubric: we'll propose the clinical SME scoring template in advance — happy to iterate during the kickoff.
- Regarding environment: Mark prefers a private project for any notes that include PHI. If Redwood can provide a VPC preview for the trial that would speed sign-off.

See you on Friday; thanks for pulling the MAP together.

—Sara
Head of Product Ops | CareMap Health
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@caremap.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@caremap.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@caremap.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Dec 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call readout + request to schedule evaluation kickoff

Thanks all — invite sent for Fri 2026-12-24 13:00 PT (60m). Agenda is attached in the invite and I re-attached the MAP + prompt template here for convenience (CareMap_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, prompt_sample_v2.csv).

Prework for the call (short): 
- CareMap: upload redacted notes + initial SME rubric (Sara / Mark)
- Redwood: we will provision a private trial project preview and share access details during the call; Ben will bring suggested runtime configs + expected latency profiles.
- Both: agree on single point of contact for trial ops (CareMap -> Sara; Redwood -> Neha).

If anything changes to attendees or the dataset timeline, flag me and we'll adjust. Looking forward to a focused kickoff and a quick pilot iteration.

Best,
Priyom

Attachments: CareMap_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, prompt_sample_v2.csv
